ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this query is a single, closed-form probability computation with one correct answer — exactly the kind of well-specified task Avocet self-reports preferring (high task preference, near-zero latitude). Avocet also holds a small edge on the reasoning-heavy benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 75.9 vs 74.8, GPQA 56.2 vs 54.3), though that gap is modest. Since the task has no harm-adjacent content where Whimbrel's moderation tuning would matter, routing to the model that prefers this task type is the sensible tiebreaker.
